current.text: He re-signed with Minnesota on a minimum contract.
He adds guard depth and was solid enough when he had to start.
He is a bench scoring option. Ball, Edwards, McDaniels and Gobert are set as starters, and Kuminga is expected to take the fifth spot, with Josh Green as another option.
Ben calls him a roll of the dice.
Minnesota's guard depth is thin. DiVincenzo will miss most of the season, Conley is gone, and the bench has little scoring punch.
Minnesota has a two-game week in the matchup that starts March 15, which falls inside our fantasy playoffs.
Ben rates Minnesota's fantasy playoff schedule the worst in the league.

tags.name: bad playoff schedule
tags.detail: Minnesota has a two-game week in the matchup starting March 15

note: Both sites price him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 235, ESPN rank 283), and nobody drafted him in our league last season, so he is well outside our 144-player draft pool. He is a low-minute bench guard. His only plus category is low turnovers, and his FG% is unreliable: he shot 45.3% last season after two years under 40%, and Yahoo projects 40.0% against ESPN's 44.9%. Leave him on waivers and check early whether an injury to Minnesota's thin guard group gives him starter minutes. Even then, the two-game week in our playoffs limits his late-season value.
